name: Cotija
siboNotes: As an aged hard cheese, cotija is naturally low in lactose and well-tolerated by most people with SIBO. The aging process removes most lactose content.
preparationTips: Crumble over dishes just before serving to maintain texture
Store wrapped in parchment paper in refrigerator to prevent moisture buildup
Grate fresh for best flavor rather than using pre-grated versions
Can be used as a finishing cheese for both hot and cold dishes
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of calcium for bone health
Contains probiotics from the aging process
